title: GRU Airport — Passenger Dispute with LATAM Staff (Full Consolidated)
subtitle: LATAM Counter / Boarding Area
location: GRU (Guarulhos) International Airport, São Paulo, Brazil — LATAM Counter / Boarding Area
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential

participants.role: LATAM Staff 2 — secondary employee, logistics explanation

cluster_A_hotel_accommodation_dispute.summary: Passenger Leandro Disconzi arrives on a delayed flight from Santiago, misses connection to Goiânia, and is rebooked for 7:10 AM. He protests the offered hotel (Ibis, 30 min away) because it would not allow adequate rest. He states he must travel with a cat and is missing his father's birthday/failing health. Counter staff explains LATAM does not have a contract with that hotel, and the system is limited.

cluster_B_communication_and_logistics_fa.summary: Passenger criticizes LATAM for lack of communication about delays. Staff explains crew-hour limitations, Congonhas noise curfew ('lei do silêncio'), and logistics. Passenger argues the airline should have communicated earlier, coordinated baggage, or allowed passengers with connections to disembark first. Staff admits the system is not customer-focused. Passenger discloses financial loss of R$4,000 due to cancelling a previous ticket for his cat.

cluster_C_schedule_and_routing_confusion.summary: Passenger discusses bus schedules, alternative routes (Congonhas, Palmas, Gurupi). He calculates travel times and becomes frustrated with the rebooking options. The timestamps indicate he has been waiting since 11 PM and it is now 2 AM.

cluster_D_confrontation_with_André_BD_Ma.summary: Passenger asks for staff name. André BD Marinho self-identifies and tells the passenger to find him on social media. Passenger refuses, stating he will make a formal complaint to LATAM. Marinho responds defensively, claiming the passenger called him 'careca' (bald) and '24'. Passenger denies this. Marinho uses profanity ('vai tomar no cu'), passenger records the interaction ('tá gravando'), Marinho acknowledges the recording and repeats profanities. Marinho tells passenger to 'baixar a bola' (back off); passenger refuses. Staff 2 intervenes to provide meal voucher information (Subway, R$80). Marinho continues with hostile comments ('se liga, filho', 'manso'). Passenger concludes by telling Marinho he needs more professionalism because he represents LATAM, not himself.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: LATAM employee André BD Marinho self-identifies by name and confirms he works for LATAM at the GRU counter.
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: Confirmed by metadata in CSV and .txt files; employee can be identified for complaint/disciplinary action.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Employee André BD Marinho directs profane insults at passenger, including 'vai tomar no cu' and 'cuzão do caralho', while acknowledging the passenger is recording.
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: Recording captures employee explicitly stating he is sending passenger to 'tomar no cu'.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Passenger Leandro Disconzi claims financial loss of R$ 4,000 (approx. USD 730) due to cancelled connection and rebooking, partly caused by travel with a pet cat.
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: Passenger statement; requires verification against LATAM ticket records.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Passenger states he is missing his father's birthday and that his father may be dying ('talvez está falecendo'), adding emotional urgency to the dispute.
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: Direct statement captured on recording; corroborates passenger motivation.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: LATAM staff acknowledges the passenger is recording and does not object; passenger repeats 'que bom que eu tenho tudo gravado' (good thing I have it all recorded).
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: Confirms mutual awareness of recording, supporting admissibility in legal proceedings under Brazilian one-party consent law.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Staff 2 confirms the offered hotel (Ibis) is 30 minutes away and that LATAM cannot guarantee a closer hotel due to system limitations.
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: Direct admission of inadequate accommodation option for passenger with early morning flight.

segments.speaker: Passenger (Leandro Disconzi)
segments.text: É BD?

segments.speaker: Passenger (Leandro Disconzi)
segments.text: Tu vai escutar de mim, amigo.

segments.speaker: LATAM Staff (André BD Marinho)
segments.text: Ah, beleza.

segments.speaker: Passenger (Leandro Disconzi)
segments.text: Fique bem.

segments.speaker: Passenger (Leandro Disconzi)
segments.text: Suave? Que bom, que bom.

segments.speaker: Passenger (Leandro Disconzi)
segments.text: Que bom. Que se a LATAM não fizer algo a respeito...

segments.speaker: Passenger (Leandro Disconzi)
segments.text: É, eu duvido um pouco.

segments.speaker: Passenger (Leandro Disconzi)
segments.text: Tá? Tenham boa noite.
